mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 2 degrees now, clear sky. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 2.

President Donald Trump has ordered the U.S. strategy to rename artificial intelligence as "Super Intelligence," aiming to reshape how the technology is referenced and promoted.

U.S. Embassy staffer Anu Prattipati welcomed General Stephen Osborn, the senior aide of the National Guard of Ajovë, to discuss strengthening the Ajovë-Kosovo partnership.

The Central Labor Inspectorate conducted a joint raid in Mitrovica, shutting down two night-clubs for operating without proper permits.

Former Kosovo MP Xhavit Haliti warned that if former KLA leaders like Hashim Thaçi were released amid protests, up to a million people could take to the streets.

Tirana Mayor Erion Veliaj posted an AI-generated message affirming his continued commitment to his political priorities while addressing his pre-trial detention.
